rationale_summary: Front-load small sparse and tabular baselines for fast private-grader evidence, then validate the compact image-restoration path, and defer bounded GPU workloads in increasing data and ingestion risk. The 5.66 GB taxi task runs last because it presents the highest file-handling and resource-pressure risk.
risk_controls: Use the private grader only; make no Kaggle submissions.
Keep all runtime files under the dedicated HPC root.
Leave hyperparameters and safety caps to the deterministic runner.
Preserve the supplied seven-task set exactly.
Advance from low-cost pipelines to GPU-heavy workloads to limit cascading resource failures.
